title: Course Objectives
items: Design, implement, test, and debug Python programs using fundamental programming constructs.
Analyze programming problems and select appropriate problem-solving strategies and data types to develop software solutions.
Apply problem decomposition and structured design techniques.
Apply variables, expressions, data types, and assignment statements to represent and manipulate information within software applications.
Design algorithms and implement programs using sequence, selection, and repetition control structures.
Develop modular applications using functions and parameter passing.
Apply scope, visibility, and variable lifetime concepts when designing, testing, and debugging programs.
Design and implement object-oriented programs using classes, objects, attributes, and methods.
Apply software engineering principles including documentation, readability, maintainability, and testing.
Create applications that utilize Python collection data types, file input/output, and exception handling.
